meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Search, install, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use BEFORE hand-building any named visual — whenever a brief, a user, or a storyboard names a look, effect, treatment, or transition such as CRT scanlines, glitch, chromatic aberration, film grain, a shimmer sweep, a chart, a code or terminal window, a map, or a confetti burst — because roughly 400 hosted items already cover many of them and the search ranks all of them with nothing installed, no project, and no account. Also use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把翻找特效的时间变成一句命令,直接把现成素材装进画面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做动效或视频画面时总要临时到处找现成的特效和转场。
copy.tagline_en: Search and drop ready-made visual effects and transitions into your scenes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep hunting for ready-made effects and transitions while building scenes.

howto.what: 做视频视觉前，Claude 会先在 HyperFrames 注册表（约 400 个条目）里搜同名效果，用 hyperframes add 安装块或组件，再把它们接进你的 index.html 合成；也能按模板帮你创作新条目并提 PR。
howto.when: 当简报、用户或分镜提到某个具名效果或转场（如 CRT 扫描线、故障、胶片颗粒等），或要运行 hyperframes add、catalog 时触发。

howto.what_en: Before building any named visual by hand, Claude searches the HyperFrames registry (~400 items), installs the matching block or component with hyperframes add, and wires it into index.html. It can also scaffold a new item for a PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a brief, user, or storyboard names a look, effect, or transition (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, etc.), or when running hyperframes add or catalog.
